d: Two figures appear: one with pastel pink, chin-length hair and golden-yellow eyes, and the other with pale cyan, chin-length hair and golden-yellow eyes; both have youthful, adolescent appearances and slender builds. The pink-haired figure wears a white and gold short dress with star motifs and white calf-high boots with gold stars, while the cyan-haired figure wears a white and gold crop top and shorts. Both possess a single gold horn on their forehead and large, feathered wings in shades of gold and white. BODY COLOR: Pale ivory LEGS: Plantigrade with human-style feet
